name: drago-ex/project-gallery
description: Image gallery in the administration of Drago Project, for images in the content of articles and pages.

suggest.ext-gd: Resizes the uploaded images; the Docker image of drago-ex/project-docker has it.
suggest.ext-intl: Keeps readable file names of uploads with accented letters; the Docker image of drago-ex/project-docker has it.
suggest.drago-ex/permission: Generates the access rules of the gallery administration (bin/create-gallery-permission).
suggest.drago-ex/project-permission: Role and permission management in the administration, which registers the generated providers.
suggest.drago-ex/project-backend-ui: Administration layout; the gallery uses its content widget.
